title: Stungeon
subtitle: Learn German. Survive the dungeon.
error_returned: Something went wrong. The error was saved to logs/error.log.
class_hint: Left/Right or 1-3 to choose  -  Enter to start  -  Esc to go back
dungeon_hint: Arrow keys or WASD to move  -  walk into an enemy to fight  -  Esc for the title screen
hotbar_hint: Your moves. Hover a slot to read about it.
new_floor: You go down to floor {n}. You recover some HP.
level_up: Level up! You are now level {level}.
combat_choose_hint: Keys 1-{n}, or Left/Right and Enter, or click a slot  -  Esc to run away
combat_choose_hint_boss: Keys 1-{n}, or Left/Right and Enter, or click a slot  -  you cannot run from a boss
hint_multi: Press 1-{n} or click to tick every correct answer, then Enter
hint_typed: Type your answer and press Enter (ae/oe/ue/ss work for umlauts)
utility_used: You use {move}. (It has no effect yet.)
enemy_misses: The {enemy} attacks, but it does no damage!
back_to_title: Press Enter to return to the title screen
